Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 114. Category: feat. Namekian Feat.

Requires: Fusing with at least 3 Namekians and either
Orange or Red-Eyed Namekian
You are the hero the Namekian Book of Prophecy spoke
of. You can now use Super Namekian and your
Required Transformation as a Combination
Transformation.
